Slider

Source: R/slider.R
slider.Rd

Detects debris flow based on the identification of hollows and critical slope thresholds.

Usage

slider(x, sp_range, crs, less_int_slope, more_int_slope, c)

Arguments

x

Input DEM raster file.

sp_range

Numeric. Number of neighbor cells for multiscalar analysis.

crs

Input geodesic reference systems.

less_int_slope

Numeric. Minimum slope angle.

more_int_slope

Numeric. Maximum slope angle.

c

Concave-concave slope (hollows), referring to code 11, see details in slopeforms.

Examples

library(terra)
library(slope)
dem <- terra::rast(system.file("ex/elev.tif", package = "terra"))
sd <- slope::slider(dem, 7, 'EPSG:5880', 21, 25, 11)
plot(sd)
